response.justification: The candidate brings genuine geospatial experience (founder of GISCollective, GIS work for Green Map) and low-latency systems work handling millions of requests per second at Dunnhumby, but that systems work was in DLang rather than the required C++ or Rust. His C/C++ experience is dated (2014–2015 at National Instruments), and his recent roles are TypeScript/Node full-stack product work with no routing, navigation guidance, or map-tiling pipeline experience. He shows strong learning agility and breadth, which the role values, but the core language and navigation-domain gaps make him a borderline fit worth a technical screen rather than a clear yes.
strengths: Hands-on geospatial/GIS platform experience, including founding and operating an open-source geo-data platform
Proven low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems work (async I/O, caching, fibers) at commercial scale
Demonstrated adaptability across the full stack and strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling)
concerns: No recent modern C++ or any Rust experience; primary systems language is DLang
No direct routing, navigation guidance, or map-tile pipeline background
Recent years focused on TypeScript/Node product and pricing work, away from systems-level engineering
